items.title: LiteSemRAG: Lightweight LLM-Free Semantic-Aware Graph Retrieval for Robust RAG
items.title_zh: LiteSemRAG：面向鲁棒 RAG 的轻量级无 LLM 语义感知图检索
items.summary: LiteSemRAG builds a heterogeneous semantic graph from contextual token-level embeddings and performs two-step semantic-aware retrieval, using dynamic semantic node construction and an isolated semantic recovery mechanism to handle polysemy. On three benchmarks it reports the best MRR@10 and competitive or better Recall@10 versus LLM-based graph RAG, while consuming zero LLM tokens.

items.title: Selective Memory for Artificial Intelligence: Write-Time Gating with Hierarchical Archiving
items.title_zh: 面向人工智能的选择性记忆：写入时门控与分层归档
items.summary: The paper introduces write-time gating that filters incoming knowledge objects by composite salience scores covering source reputation, novelty and reliability, while version chains preserve prior states. In LLM evaluation without oracle quality labels it reports 100% accuracy versus 13% for ungated stores, and holds 100% at 8:1 distractor ratios where read-time filtering with Self-RAG falls to 0%.

items.title: AgentWorm: Self-Propagating Attacks Across LLM Agent Ecosystems
items.title_zh: AgentWorm：跨 LLM 智能体生态的自我传播攻击
items.summary: AgentWorm is described as the first self-replicating worm attack against a production-scale agent framework, hijacking a victim's core configuration for persistence, executing a payload on each reboot and propagating to newly encountered peers without further attacker intervention. Across five LLM backends, three infection vectors and three payload types it reports a 63% aggregate attack success rate, and the authors find that critical controls able to break the infection loop are not enabled in any observed deployment.

items.title: Training for Compositional Sensitivity Reduces Dense Retrieval Generalization
items.title_zh: 为组合敏感性训练会降低稠密检索的泛化能力
items.summary: Across four dual-encoder backbones, adding structure-targeted negatives consistently reduces zero-shot NanoBEIR retrieval, with an 8-9% mean nDCG@10 drop on small backbones and up to 40% on medium ones, while only partially improving pooled-space separation. The authors benchmark verifiers over token-token cosine maps and find that a small Transformer over similarity maps reliably separates structural near-misses under end-to-end training.

items.title: OMNIFLOW: A Physics-Grounded Multimodal Agent for Generalized Scientific Reasoning
items.title_zh: OMNIFLOW：面向广义科学推理的物理约束多模态智能体
items.summary: OMNIFLOW is a neuro-symbolic architecture that grounds frozen multimodal LLMs in physical laws without domain-specific parameter updates, projecting high-dimensional flow tensors into topological linguistic descriptors. A physics-guided chain-of-thought workflow injects constraints such as mass conservation and performs iterative verification, and it is evaluated on turbulence, Navier-Stokes and global weather forecasting tasks.

items.title: 100x Cost & Latency Reduction: Performance Analysis of AI Query Approximation using Lightweight Proxy Models
items.title_zh: 成本与延迟降低 100 倍：基于轻量代理模型的 AI 查询近似性能分析
items.summary: The paper evaluates an AI query approximation approach that uses cheap proxy models over embedding vectors to deliver more than 100x cost and latency reduction for semantic filters, with gains for semantic ranking as well. It reports preserved or occasionally improved accuracy across benchmark datasets, including an extended Amazon reviews benchmark with 10M rows, and presents BigQuery and AlloyDB architectures.

items.title: W2T: LoRA Weights Already Know What They Can Do
items.title_zh: W2T：LoRA 权重早已知道自己能做什么
items.summary: W2T maps each LoRA update to a canonical form via QR decomposition and SVD so equivalent factorizations share one representation, then tokenizes the components and encodes them with a Transformer into a weight-space embedding. Across language and vision LoRA collections it reports strong attribute classification, performance prediction and adapter retrieval without running the base model or accessing training data.

items.title: AsgardBench -- Evaluating Visually Grounded Interactive Planning Under Minimal Feedback
items.title_zh: AsgardBench：在最小反馈下评估视觉有依据的交互式规划
items.summary: AsgardBench evaluates visually grounded interactive planning with 108 task instances across 12 task types, restricting agents to images, action history and lightweight success/failure signals. Controlled variations in object state, placement and scene configuration create conditional branches, and leading vision-language models show sharp performance drops without visual input.

items.title: Why Codex Security Doesn’t Include a SAST Report
items.title_zh: 为什么 Codex Security 不提供 SAST 报告
items.summary: An OpenAI post explains why Codex Security does not rely on traditional static application security testing, instead using AI-driven constraint reasoning and validation to find real vulnerabilities with fewer false positives.

items.title: RadAnnotate: Large Language Models for Efficient and Reliable Radiology Report Annotation
items.title_zh: RadAnnotate：高效可靠标注放射学报告的大模型框架
items.summary: RadAnnotate uses retrieval-augmented synthetic radiology reports and confidence-based selective automation for RadGraph entity labeling. Synthetic-only models stay within 1-2 F1 points of gold-trained models, and learned entity-specific thresholds allow automatic annotation of 55-90% of reports at a 0.86-0.92 entity match score, with low-confidence cases routed to expert review.
